query: SELECT death_date, COUNT(*) AS death_count FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala WHERE person_type = 'Saudi' AND death_date IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM death_date) = 2024 GROUP BY death_date ORDER BY death_date LIMIT 1200
raw_question: ماهو توزيع السعوديين المتوفين في 2024 بحسب الأيام؟
